result.summary: The intersection features high-visibility crosswalks and curb ramps with tactile paving, providing a basic level of pedestrian accessibility. However, the wide crossing distance and parked vehicles near the corner create visibility challenges and increase exposure to traffic.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Cars
hazards.description: Cars parked along the curb right up to the crosswalk block sightlines between pedestrians and approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the image along the curb near the crosswalk.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The wide roadway increases the time pedestrians are exposed to vehicle traffic without a refuge island.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground crosswalk across the main roadway.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten crossing distance and improve visibility by daylighting the intersection.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalk to ensure clear sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

result.summary: The intersection features high-visibility continental crosswalks and well-maintained sidewalks in a residential setting. However, the wide multi-lane roadway creates a significant crossing distance for pedestrians without the protection of a median refuge or visible dedicated pedestrian signals.

hazards.name: Long crossing distance
hazards.description: The wide multi-lane road increases the time pedestrians are exposed to vehicle traffic without a mid-point refuge.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the main roadway in the foreground

hazards.name: Visual obstruction from parked cars
hazards.description: Vehicles parked close to the intersection on the left side may block sightlines between pedestrians and approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the intersection along the curb

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Add a raised median refuge to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking near the crosswalk to ensure clear sightlines for all road users.

result.summary: The image shows a wide four-way intersection with marked crosswalks and curb ramps, but it lacks pedestrian refuge islands or visible pedestrian-specific signals. The environment is dominated by multi-lane vehicle traffic, creating a long exposure time for pedestrians crossing the roadway.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross at least four lanes of traffic without a median refuge, increasing exposure to vehicles.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: No dedicated pedestrian signal heads are clearly visible to indicate when it is safe to cross.

result.summary: The intersection features high-visibility continental crosswalk markings and traffic signal control, providing basic pedestrian infrastructure. However, the wide roadway with multiple travel lanes and the absence of a median refuge island create a significant unprotected crossing distance.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross at least four lanes of traffic in a single stage without a refuge island.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Buffer
hazards.description: The sidewalk is directly adjacent to the travel lanes with no physical buffer like trees or a furniture zone.
